confidence_notes: Medium for restaurant and drink anchors, which follow Cambodian tourist-area pricing; lower for hotel tiers, which vary widely by beach zone and season. Anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge, not checked against live menus, listings, or booking pages. Cocktail and wine were set from the local price relationship to beer (cocktail about 4x beer, wine glass about 5x beer) because direct knowledge is weak. FX: the 2026-10-16 value of 0.6947 came from search-result text attributed to the RBA exchange rates statistics, and I did not open the RBA page itself, so verify it before relying on it. The 2026-10-15 4pm value of 0.6955 appeared in the same results.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: Southeast Asian tourist towns, including Siem Reap, Phnom Penh, and Thai or Vietnamese coastal resort towns, adjusted for Sihanoukville's lower-cost guesthouse market and July green-season demand. No web search was used for the city-price anchors.
